BiblicalUsage: Integrity is the word, and the Bible gives it a face. Abimelech says he acted in the integrity of his heart and the innocency of his hands, the psalmist prays let integrity and uprightness preserve me, God tells Solomon to walk in integrity of heart as David did, and the two hundred men who went with Absalom went in their simplicity, knowing nothing.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that integrity is not a single act but a whole manner of walking: the heart and the hands agree, and the simplicity of the men with Absalom is the same word as the integrity of David. I believe God still measures His people by it — not by what they claim, but by whether heart and hands tell the same story.
